scenario.shared_setting: Four adults have shared a rented HDB flat for eight months. There is one kitchen with one stove, and all four people cook there. The household has never agreed any rules about the kitchen. It is a weeknight evening and all four are in the kitchen and the living area next to it. All four will be living here and using this kitchen again tomorrow, and for the rest of the lease.
